newsitem.title: HUNGARY: CESI comes down from peak, ends at 1,750.57 pts.
newsitem.headline: CESI comes down from peak, ends at 1,750.57 pts.

text.p: The CESI Central European Share Index came down from an all-time high it reached on Monday and on Tuesday it closed at 1,750.57 points, down 1.32 points or 0.08 percent, the Budapest Stock Exchange said.
The index, which has been published since February 1, 1996, reflects trends of 73 shares on the Budapest, Prague, Warsaw, Bratislava and Ljubljana bourses.
